channel.title: The Rural Update
channel.description: A concise daily executive briefing on rural healthcare policy, operations, finance, Oklahoma developments, federal policy, and emerging technology.
channel.itunes:author: The Rural Update
channel.itunes:summary: Daily rural healthcare executive intelligence in under 15 minutes.

item.title: The Rural Update | September 25, 2026
item.description: This is The Rural Update for Friday, September 25, 2026. The central theme this morning is that rural transformation is moving from broad policy language into specific operating models. New federal awards are showing what states are actually buying: workforce pipelines, mobile care, remote monitoring, behavioral health capacity, chronic disease management, technology modernization, and stronger regional coordination. At the same time, Oklahoma’s newest Rural Emergency Hospital continues to illustrate the tradeoff between preserving a local hospital access point and losing inpatient and swing-bed capability. There are three developments to focus on this morning, followed by the Oklahoma implications, signals, actions, and near-term deadlines.

item.title: The Rural Update | September 23, 2026
item.description: Good morning. This is The Rural Update for Wednesday, September 23, 2026. Today’s briefing is centered on three themes: rural transformation is becoming more regional and operational, federal cybersecurity policy is beginning to pair mandates with rural implementation funding, and a new North Carolina model may show how small hospitals can adopt artificial intelligence without each building its own governance infrastructure.

item.title: The Rural Update — September 22, 2026
item.description: Good morning. This is The Rural Update for Tuesday, September 22, 2026. Today’s focus is the transition from Medicaid policy advocacy into implementation, a new Medicaid drug-pricing decision window, and two developments showing how quickly clinical artificial intelligence is moving toward regulated patient-facing care.

item.title: The Rural Update | September 20, 2026
item.description: Good morning. This is The Rural Update for Sunday, September 20, 2026. Today the focus is immediate Medicaid financing, the post-grant economics of rural transformation, and the final operational runway before the October 1 RHC telehealth billing change.

item.title: The Rural Update | September 18, 2026
item.description: Good morning. This is The Rural Update for Friday, September 18, 2026. The main theme today is implementation risk: federal rural transformation dollars are moving rapidly into real infrastructure and technology, while Medicaid financing and near-term RHC billing changes still require disciplined operational follow-through.
